isRunningSqlServer.description: Portal: 'Machine is running SQL Server' checkbox (Compute and Network settings). Pre-populated from Azure Migrate SQL discovery; customer can override. Gates whether the SQL-specific settings below are surfaced for this VM.

registerWithSqlIaasExtension.description: Portal: 'Register with SQL IaaS extension' checkbox. Defaults to true. Editability is conditional: when subscriptionBulkRegistrationEnabled = true the portal locks this field on (every SQL-bearing VM in the subscription is auto-registered); when false the customer opts in per-VM. Only applies when isRunningSqlServer = true. Registration itself is performed by the Azure Migrate migrate job at cutover; this runbook only carries the flag in the replication-item payload.

sqlServerHasSoftwareAssurance.description: Portal: 'I confirm that I have a SQL Server license with Software Assurance to apply this Azure Hybrid benefit for SQL Server' checkbox. Required to actually apply SQL-AHB; only meaningful when sqlServerHybridBenefit = true.

sqlServerHybridBenefit.description: Portal: 'Azure Hybrid Benefit > I have a SQL Server license' checkbox. SQL-AHB opt-in (separate from Windows AHB licenseType). Applies only when isRunningSqlServer = true.
